topic: Radiotherapy Treatment Outcomes in Prostate Cancer
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from a clinical registry focused on prostate cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy. The dataset will include detailed treatment plans, including dosages, target volumes, and fractionation schedules, as well as patient demographics such as age, ethnicity, and comorbidities. The registry will also capture individual treatment events like session attendance, any adverse reactions, and follow-up outcomes. The data is intended to analyze the relationship between different radiotherapy protocols and patient outcomes, including survival rates and quality of life metrics.

topic: Breast Cancer Radiotherapy Protocols and Patient Demographics
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from a clinical registry that documents radiotherapy treatment for breast cancer patients. This registry will collect comprehensive patient information, including age, genetic markers, and previous treatments. It will also detail the radiotherapy plans, specifying the type of radiation used, total dose, and treatment duration. Furthermore, it will record each treatment session, documenting any deviations from the planned protocol and acute side effects. The data is intended to assess the effectiveness of varying radiotherapy protocols in different demographic groups and their impact on disease recurrence and patient recovery.

Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from a registry focused on pediatric patients receiving radiotherapy for brain tumors. The registry will include patient demographic details like age, weight, and medical history, as well as specifics of the radiotherapy treatment such as the type and dose of radiation, treatment duration, and any modifications made during the course of therapy. Additionally, it will capture data on treatment-related side effects and any subsequent interventions required. The data is intended to improve understanding of how radiotherapy protocols affect tumor control and neurological outcomes in children.
